business_problem: Hualv needed a scalable way to handle massive volumes of online legal consultations, because ordinary users often describe their legal needs vaguely and traditional legal search requires both time and specialist knowledge that most users do not have.
solution_summary: Hualv used the Qianfan large-model platform and ERNIE models to build a legal-intelligence service system centered on two user-facing capabilities: Recommended Questions for rapid intent discovery and Xiaoluxia for legal opinion generation. Qianfan lets the platform combine natural-language understanding, knowledge-graph reasoning, and intelligent search with Hualv's own large user-behavior dataset and more than two decades of accumulated legal content. Recommended Questions helps the system narrow ambiguous legal requests into specific legal-service needs, while Xiaoluxia can generate a legal opinion letter in real time from a user's consultation context. Hualv also uses the same stack to rewrite dense legal articles into more accessible language and to generate personalized assessment questionnaires from prior user interactions. The overall design therefore joins retrieval, reasoning, generation, and content transformation into a high-volume legal-service workflow that improves both user matching and downstream conversion into professional legal services.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model runtime and orchestration environment Hualv uses to connect legal data, search, reasoning, and generation workflows.

solution_components.name: Recommended Questions
solution_components.role: Helps users clarify vague legal requests and routes them toward the right legal knowledge or service paths.

solution_components.name: Xiaoluxia
solution_components.role: Generates legal opinion letters in real time from user consultation context.

data_flow: User legal questions enter the Hualv platform, Qianfan and ERNIE interpret intent against Hualv's legal content and historical interaction data, Recommended Questions narrows the issue, Xiaoluxia generates opinion content or assessment material, and the platform returns matched knowledge, services, or lawyers back to the user.
business_outcome: Hualv turned large-scale legal consultation into an intelligent service workflow, improving user-need matching, supporting personalized legal guidance, and sustaining very high daily model utilization at industry scale.
architecture_clues: The design combines NLP, knowledge graph, and intelligent search with Hualv's legal content corpus.
The same model stack powers legal question routing, opinion generation, questionnaire generation, and legal-text rewriting.
The platform uses more than 20 years of legal-domain content and large-scale user data as its domain foundation.
